subject: Recap: Data retention, SOC 2 & pen-test evidence — intake and owners
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Data retention, SOC 2 & pen-test evidence — intake and owners

Jordan — thanks again for your time today. Below is a short recap of what we covered, the items you asked for, and the owners/timeline we propose. If anything looks off, tell me and I’ll adjust.

Key pain / goals you stated
- Short retention window requirements for customer outputs (30–90 days) for sandbox environments; 7 years for regulated audit archives for specific transaction logs.
- Need for auditable, immutable audit logs for query and access events (SOC 2 / internal audit).
- Confirmation you require a successful customer-run pen test or attestation and evidence of Redwood’s remediation cadence.
- DPA language that supports data residency and deletion guarantees.

Requested deliverables from Redwood
1) SOC 2 summary and exportable evidence catalog (control mappings we can send by 2027-04-06) — owner: Marissa Cole
2) Audit log retention options & sample schema export for your SIEM team — owner: Karthik Iyer
3) Pen-test scope we recommend + list of recent third-party test artifacts (redacted reports) — owner: Dev Patel
4) DPA draft with retention and subprocessing language for legal review (initial draft attached) — owner: Hannah Schmitt

Attachments referenced: nimbus-pen-test-scope.pdf (scope proposal), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (control summary), dpa-draft-nimbus.docx (draft DPA).

Proposed timeline
- 2027-04-06: deliver SOC2 summary + evidence catalog stub
- 2027-04-09: deliver audit log schema and retention options
- 2027-04-12: provide pen-test scope and available redacted artifacts
- 2027-04-16: DPA draft iteration complete for your legal review

Immediate next step for Jordan: confirm the primary technical contact for audit log ingestion (SIEM) and the legal contact for DPA redlines.

Thanks — will loop in the rest of the team on internal intake.

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusfin.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Data retention, SOC 2 & pen-test evidence — intake and owners

Thanks Hannah, this looks right.
- Technical owner for logs will be Priya Menon (priya.menon@nimbusfin.com) — she’ll want the schema first.
- Legal contact is Samir Patel (samir.patel@nimbusfin.com).

A couple clarifications:
1) For pen-test artifacts: redacted reports are fine, but we need confirmation of the test date and CVE/issue IDs referenced so our vuln management team can cross-check.
2) On retention: the 7-year archive only applies to settled-settlement transaction records — we can provide a whitelist of record types by Friday.

If you can get the SOC 2 mapping and the log schema by next week that’ll help expedite the internal kickoff.

Jordan
Head of Security Operations | Nimbus Financial
security@nimbusfin.com

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusfin.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Data retention, SOC 2 & pen-test evidence — intake and owners

Team — forwarding Nimbus’ confirmations. Action items below; please reply with ETA and any blockers.

Marissa: SOC 2 mapping + exportable evidence list by 2027-04-06. Nimbus will use it for their compliance intake. They may ask for raw artifact snippets (redacted) later.

Karthik: audit log schema (fields, timestamps, IMMUTABLE event IDs, retention tiers) and an example export (CSV/JSON) for Priya. Target 2027-04-09. Priya’s email: priya.menon@nimbusfin.com.

Dev: pen-test scope proposal and list of recent tests. Jordan needs test dates and CVE references alongside redacted reports. Can you include the recommended test window and approximate cost estimate? Target 2027-04-12.

Legal (looping in you informally) — I’ll circulate the DPA draft once I get Marissa’s SOC wording in case we need to reference cert names verbatim.

Please mark any item you cannot meet and suggest an alternate date.

Thanks all — Hannah

---

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimbusfin.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Data retention, SOC 2 & pen-test evidence — intake and owners

I can take point on the pen-test package. Quick notes and what I’ll deliver: 
- Pen-test artifacts: I’ll assemble redacted reports from the last two tests (2026-11 and 2025-05) and include a one-page table that lists test date, scope, critical/high findings, and CVE refs where applicable.
- Scope proposal: include recommended external + internal testing (API fuzzing, model-inference surfaces), and specific endpoints we suggest for attack surface validation.
- Estimate: ballpark external vendor cost range attached in scope PDF.

ETA: I’ll upload the redacted reports and scope PDF to our secure share by 2027-04-12 EOD. Jordan — is there a preferred transmission method for redacted artifacts? We can use an encrypted link or SFTP.

--
Dev Patel
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

[Attachments: nimbus-pen-test-scope.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf), dpa-draft-nimbus.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
